{

    "Begin every newly created .ts or .tsx file with the Backstage Apache-2.0 license header dated 2026 (Copyright 2026 The Backstage Authors).",

The requested revisions have been applied and validated across the updated change-spec sections:

1. **Per-package adopter-facing changesets (`units-004.json`)**:
   - Replaced the single combined changeset with two separate single-package changeset units:
     - `U18` (`.changeset/notifications-unread-home-card.md`): `'@backstage/plugin-notifications': patch`, written in plain adopter-facing language about the unread notifications homepage card/widget, live refresh, mark-as-read actions, and deep-link highlighting without internal code identifiers.
     - `U19` (`.changeset/home-react-card-fallback.md`): `'@backstage/plugin-home-react': patch`, written in plain adopter-facing language about homepage cards falling back to a default loading indicator when rendered outside a full Backstage app context, without naming internal symbols.
2. **Visual row highlighting without test-only attributes (`header.json`, `units-002.json`, `units-003.json`)**:
   - Removed `data-highlighted` and any test-only DOM attributes from the decision in `header.json` and from `U07` ([NotificationsTable.tsx](file:///Users/apple/Documents/GitHub/bs-cells/BS-NF-09-argon-attempt2/plugins/notifications/src/components/NotificationsTable/NotificationsTable.tsx)), keeping only user-visible styling (`styles.highlighted` and `options.rowStyle`).
   - Updated `U15` (`plugins/notifications/src/components/HomePageUnreadNotifications/HomePageUnreadNotifications.test.tsx`) rules and test expectation to locate notification rows via `screen.findByText` and assert on user-perceivable row styling with no test IDs or test-only attributes.
